Download the FANTOM CAT Companion Tables

Source: R/download_reference.R
download_fantom_cat_tables.Rd

Fetches, for one FANTOM CAT level, the ID mapping table (transcript to CAGE cluster), the gene information table and the CAGE cluster BED file, which add_fantom_cat_tables() joins into an annotation directory.

Usage

download_fantom_cat_tables(
  level = c("lv3_robust", "lv4_stringent", "lv2_permissive", "lv1_raw"),
  tables = c("id_mapping", "gene_info", "cage_clusters"),
  output_path = ":cache:",
  timeout_limit = 3600,
  method = "auto"
)

Arguments

level

FANTOM CAT level: "lv3_robust" (default), "lv1_raw", "lv2_permissive" or "lv4_stringent".

tables

Which tables to download.

output_path

Directory where the file is saved. Defaults to ":cache:", the package cache (see get_isoformic_cache()).

timeout_limit

Maximum time in seconds for the download. Takes precedence over options("timeout"). Defaults to 3600.

method

Method used by utils::download.file(). Defaults to "auto".

Value

A named character vector of file paths (id_mapping, gene_info, cage_clusters).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
tables <- download_fantom_cat_tables("lv3_robust")
tables
} # }
